metrics.label: Do I need an ABN?
metrics.detail: Free via the ABR. Selling apps for profit, repeatedly, is likely a business. Get it before 20 Nov.

metrics.label: When must I register for GST?
metrics.detail: When current or projected 12-month GST turnover hits A$75,000. The base case is around 2028–29. Apple needs it earlier.

metrics.label: Sole trader or company?
metrics.detail: Start as a sole trader. Revisit a company once profit you can leave in the business is consistently tens of thousands a year.

week: Read your employment contract for IP assignment, outside-work and conflict clauses, and get written permission if anything is unclear.
Apply for an ABN as a sole trader (free, abr.gov.au). Register a business name (A$47 for 1 year) only if you trade under a name that is not your own.
Rename GiftLedger and Renewal Radar: both names are already live apps. Then search IP Australia's TM Checker and file in class 9, and class 42 if you want it (A$250 per class).
Open a separate bank account, choose bookkeeping software, and start a set-aside for tax (about 30–39% of profit on top of a salary; assumption).
Publish a privacy policy, terms of use and an ACL-compliant refund policy. Make the marketing signup Spam Act compliant: consent, sender identification, and unsubscribe within 5 business days.
surprisesIntro: Apple requires Australia-based developers to hold a GST registration to sell paid apps, even below A$75,000. Google Play makes Australian developers remit GST on Australian sales themselves, so the web merchant of record is the low-admin launch channel. From 1 July 2027, new subscription rules apply, three months before the Pass launches in October 2027. Selling through an offshore reseller is not automatically a GST-free export: sales to Australian end users may be taxable once you are registered. That point is unsettled.
timeline: Now, before 20 Nov 2026

Read your employment contract and get written OK if it is unclear. Apply for an ABN as a sole trader. Rename GiftLedger and Renewal Radar. Run a trade mark search and file class 9, and class 42 if you want it. Open a separate bank account. Start records and a tax set-aside. Publish a privacy policy, terms and an ACL-compliant refund policy. Pick a reseller-model merchant of record. Do not register for GST yet unless you want the App Store.

ABN free. Business name A$47 for 1 year or A$108 for 3 years only if you trade under a name that is not your own. Trade mark A$250 per class on the picklist. A .com.au is about A$10–30 a year at retail (assumption).

Record each merchant-of-record payout from its transaction report, not the bank deposit. Convert USD at the rate when the amount is derived, or a reasonable average. Keep reports for 5 years. Set aside about 30–39% of profit (marginal rate plus Medicare; assumption).
Accounting app about A$0–35 a month (assumption).

Business schedule on your individual return for 2026–27, due 31 Oct 2027, or later through a tax agent. Claim business-use deductions. Expect PAYG instalments once business income is A$4,000 or more and tax payable is A$1,000 or more.
A return with a business schedule is about A$330–440 from one provider (indicative).

Unfair trading practices law starts: subscription disclosures, reminders, easy cancellation, no dark patterns, and a drip-pricing ban. Build these into the Pass before the October 2027 launch.
Your time, plus a legal review of the checkout. Get quotes.

The merchant of record handles customer VAT and sales tax where it covers those countries. You still handle Australian income tax and your own GST. The GDPR and UK GDPR apply if you target those users. The device-only design keeps that smaller.

sections.heading: ABN, and hobby versus business
rows: The ATO looks at the whole picture: intention and prospect of profit, repetition, and business-like records. Building several paid apps, marketing them and planning a subscription points to a business. Treat it as one from day one.

You are entitled to an ABN if you carry on, or are starting, an enterprise in Australia. Applying through the ABR is free. Once you are carrying on an enterprise you cannot use a statement by a supplier to avoid withholding.
Australian businesses paying you must withhold 47% if you do not quote an ABN, unless the payment is A$75 or less excluding GST, or another exception applies.
A sole trader using their own name needs no business name. Anything else is A$47 for 1 year or A$108 for 3 years through ASIC. Register the name you actually trade under.
A .com.au needs an Australian presence. An ABN qualifies. The name must match your name, business name, trade mark, or the product you provide.

sections.heading: Business structure

rows: Your marginal rate on all profit, plus 2% Medicare. In 2026–27 that is 30% from A$45,001, 37% from A$135,001 and 45% from A$190,001.
25% for a base rate entity. Dividends are taxed later at your rate, with franking credits.
Profits go to beneficiaries. More admin, and only with family-planning advice.
Limited, but directors have duties and banks often want guarantees.
Depends on the trustee. Often a corporate trustee.
A$636 to register, A$342 a year, a free director ID, and a separate return.
A deed and accountant fees. Get quotes.
They offset salary only if you pass the non-commercial loss rules.

notes: PSI
Personal services income rules target income that is mainly for your personal effort. Selling finished apps or licences is generally not PSI. Paid custom work or consulting could be.
Non-commercial losses

Early losses offset salary only if taxable income is under A$250,000 and you pass one test: A$20,000 or more of assessable business income, a profit in 3 of the last 5 years, A$500,000 or more of real property, or A$100,000 or more of other assets. Otherwise the loss is deferred. Expect a year-1 loss to be deferred.
When to switch (assumption)

A company saves about 5 cents per dollar left in it if your top rate is 30%, and about 12 cents if it is 37%, against perhaps A$2,000–3,000 a year of extra cost. The rough break-even is A$20,000–50,000 of retained profit a year. The base case reaches about A$64,000 cumulative by April 2028 and about A$73,000 a year by 2029, so review it in 2027–28. Have an accountant model the move, including CGT and transferring the IP.

sections.heading: GST
rows: Register if current GST turnover (this month plus the previous 11) or projected turnover (this month plus the next 11) is A$75,000 or more. Register within 21 days. GST-free sales, including exports, count toward the threshold.
Turnover through a merchant of record

Under a reseller model your supply is to the merchant of record. Turnover is what it pays you for the licence, not the customer price and not the bank deposit. That reading is from a CPA firm's October 2026 guide. Confirm it with your agent.
Is the sale to the merchant GST-free?

Section 38-190 can make a supply to a non-resident GST-free. Subsection 38-190(3) can deny that where the thing is provided to someone in Australia. A secondary source says an ATO ruling indicates the Australian-consumer share may be taxable to you once you are registered. The ruling was not opened in this run. Below the threshold, and while you are unregistered, this costs nothing. After registration, budget one-eleventh of the Australian share. A private ruling is the way to pin it down.
A registered electronic distribution platform can agree in writing to be treated as the supplier of your taxable sales. Ask any merchant which clause and which section it relies on.

Apple requires Australia-based developers to have a GST registration to sell paid apps, and it asks for your ABN and proof. A paid app or in-app purchase on the App Store effectively forces voluntary registration and BAS.

Google handles GST only for developers outside Australia. If you are in Australia you charge and remit 10% GST on Australian sales. If you are not registered, Google may charge GST on its service fee.

You can claim GST credits on Australian costs and become eligible for Apple, and annual GST reporting is available while turnover is under A$75,000. You also send one-eleventh of taxable Australian sales to the ATO, about A$1.73 of an A$19 sale, and you lodge BAS. Overseas VAT and US sales tax on sales the merchant covers are not your GST.
Consumer prices must include GST and compulsory fees. Once registered, keep A$19 and A$29 GST-inclusive and absorb the one-eleventh.

sections.heading: Income tax, records and BAS
notes: How it is taxed

Business profit goes on your individual return and is added to your salary. The tax-free A$18,200 is normally already used by a job, so side profit is taxed from your marginal rate, plus 2% Medicare. The 15% bracket drops to 14% from 1 July 2027.
PAYG instalments
The ATO enters you once a return shows A$4,000 or more of instalment income, tax payable of A$1,000 or more, and notional tax of A$500 or more. Instalments are quarterly prepayments.
Deductions

AI subscriptions, the Grok Bot plan, hosting, domains, developer accounts, merchant fees, trade mark fees, accounting, insurance and software are deductible to the extent they are for the business. The A$20,000 instant asset write-off is permanent from 1 July 2026. The home-office fixed rate is 70 cents an hour for 2025–26, with a full-year record of hours, or you claim actual costs.
USD payouts
Convert each amount at the rate when it is derived or received, whichever is earlier. For regular income you may use an average rate for up to 12 months if it is reasonable. Keep the rate source.
Records
Keep them for 5 years from lodging: merchant reports, payouts, invoices, receipts, FX rates, and a diary for home and device use.
BAS
None until you register for GST. Then quarterly is the default, due 28 October, 28 February, 28 April and 28 July. Annual GST reporting is only for voluntary registrants under A$75,000.
TPAR

Needed only if you provide IT services and pay contractors to deliver them, and IT services are 10% or more of income. Selling finished apps is not obviously IT services. Check before you hire contractors. Due 28 August.

sections.heading: Employing and contractors
rows: 12% of ordinary time earnings. Payday super from 1 July 2026 must reach the fund within 7 business days of payday. Contractors paid mainly for their labour can be owed super even with an ABN.
A policy is required once you pay more than A$7,500 in wages in a financial year, or if you have apprentices or trainees.
It applies only above an annual wages threshold (A$1.2 million on Revenue NSW figures; not re-checked this run). It is not relevant at this scale.
Use the ATO and Fair Work tests: control, who bears the risk, and whether they are paid for a result. Get a written IP assignment from any freelancer.

sections.heading: Australian Consumer Law
rows: Apps must be of acceptable quality, fit for purpose and match their description. You can refuse a change-of-mind refund. A no-refunds term that denies the guarantees is unlawful.

Since 9 November 2023, using an unfair term in a standard-form consumer contract is prohibited. Maximum penalties are large. Avoid one-sided price changes, broad liability exclusions and one-sided auto-renewal.

The Unfair Trading Practices Act 2026 requires key information before sign-up, notices before a trial ends, at renewal and on a price rise, and cancellation that is as easy as sign-up. It also bans drip pricing of unavoidable fees, with GST excluded. The Pass renews yearly from October 2027, so design for this now. Notice timings are still in draft regulations.
Show Australian prices including GST and compulsory fees. If you say lifetime, define it in plain words.

sections.heading: Privacy, spam and data
rows: Turnover of A$3 million or less is generally outside the Australian Privacy Principles, with exceptions for health providers, businesses that trade in personal information, and others. The 2026 tranche 2 draft keeps the exemption. Comply anyway: stores want a privacy policy.
People can sue for a serious, intentional or reckless invasion of privacy. It applies to small businesses. Keeping no server copy of user data reduces the exposure.
Still a draft. Registration is due by 10 December 2026. The apps target parents. Avoid child-directed features and child accounts.
You need consent, accurate sender identification, and an unsubscribe that works within 5 business days without a login. Keep consent records. A reply to a support email is not marketing.
It applies if you target people there. The merchant of record is its own controller for payments. Your support inbox and email list are yours. Say so in the policy.
No account database means a smaller breach surface and a shorter privacy policy. Analytics, crash tools and ads are what make a we-collect-nothing claim false.

sections.heading: IP, names and content
rows: GiftLedger and Renewal Radar are taken

GiftLedger is a live app by ReactiveWorks. Renewal Radar is a live subscription tracker by Aplo Apps. Using those names risks passing off, store rejection and confusion. Choose new names, then check the trade mark register, ASIC, the stores and domains.

IP Australia charges A$250 per class on the picklist and A$400 without it. TM Headstart starts at A$330. Class 9 covers downloadable apps. Class 42 covers online software. A registration lasts 10 years.

Australian copyright needs a human author. Purely generated output may not be protected. Human selection and editing helps. The government ruled out a text-and-data-mining exception in October 2025. The Copyright and AI Reference Group is still working on outputs.
Keep a dependency list. MIT, BSD and Apache need attribution in the app. Do not drop GPL or AGPL code into a closed app unless you understand the duty. Check snippets an agent suggests.

Dates are facts. Page text and compilations can still be protected. NSW education content is CC BY 4.0, so commercial reuse needs attribution. Check each state's terms. Tell people to verify dates with their school.

sections.heading: Liability, advice and insurance
rows: General insurance and many financial products are financial products. Factual information, with no recommendation, is generally not advice. Ranking or suggesting a policy can be financial product advice and needs an AFSL. Keep the app to dates the user enters and factual checklists. Do not recommend a product or take a commission.
Say the app is a reminder tool, not financial, insurance, legal or tax advice. Users must verify dates. Liability limits have to leave the consumer guarantees in place.

Professional indemnity for an IT sole trader is about A$850–2,941 a year in one broker's data, and bundles start near A$516. Cyber risk is low with no customer data on your servers. It is not legally required. Get quotes once there is revenue.

job: By default an employer owns copyright in work made in the course of employment. A side project in your own time, outside your duties, is generally yours. Contracts often assign more, ban outside work, or restrict work laptops and AI tools. Do not use employer devices, time or confidential information. If the job is in software, get a written carve-out that names the apps.
